description: Part 10 (Capstone) H0 - unblocker probe, SAFE half (design: work/design/part10-design-v3.md section H0). Runs entirely against <USER>2 (the default library, target of every later Part 10 batch) and never changes DBVER: the TXMIGR TO(2) steps live in the sibling batch part10-00b-dbver2, which runs against <USER>B. Run THIS batch first. Precondition: <USER>2 holds the DBVER 1 sample DB (TXSETUP done) and the legacy programs (TXLEGST present, else the FORCE run is a first build and no backup SAVF is made); the first cl steps record DBVER and the JUDLV column state of both libraries into VFY10CNT and the gate reads them (P0-PRE rows, TXSTATUS lines in VFYLOG). Steps (cl steps run as ONE wrapper job; every before/after comparison is materialised into &LIB/VFY10CNT and &LIB/VFY10OBJ first and read back by the collect steps at the end): (1) RESTOBJ discovery, read-only, RESTOBJ is NEVER called: OBJECT_STATISTICS on QSYS *CMD for RESTOBJ/RSTOBJ/RSTLIB/RSTCFG, plus sh-after DSPCMD and DSPOBJD with OUTPUT(*PRINT) (qsh returns the listing in the run section; that DSPCMD lists the parameters is expected, not verified; this step establishes existence for sure, parameter names only if the listing shows them); (2) TXLEGACY FORCE(*YES) a second time via helper TX10RUN (txlegrun.clp has no FORCE), create timestamps of ZA0500/JU0900C/JU0300/TK0100/MN0000C/TXLEGST before and after, and DSPSAVF of LG<QDATE> in <USER>B via sh-after helper TX10SAV (expect no JU0900C in the list, S17; the SAVF name is <profile>B/LG<QDATE> whatever library TXLEGACY targets, so the SAVF check is only meaningful on the first run of the day); (3) TXRESET, row counts JUCHUM 8 / JUCHUD 12 / ZAIKOM 6 and zero J00000/C05119 rows; (5, DBVER 1 half only) column-list INSERT INTO JUCHUM (JUNO, JUTOK, JUDATE, JUTAN) at DBVER 1 then DELETE, counted before and after the delete; (6) existence of the TESTKIT prerequisite objects in both libraries; extras: RTVMSG for CPF9898, CPF4174, CPC1221 (helper TX10MSG), TXCKM seed for a throwaway lesson 10-00, TXCHECK once in the wrapper job via TXCHKRUN and twice more in two separate jobs via sh-after helper TX10CHK (CPF4174 workaround check), then the seed is deleted; (4) ticket-1 fix: solutions/05-13/ju0900c-ticket1.clp is uploaded to member JU09T1 (NOT JU0900C, because TXLEGACY FORCE overwrites member JU0900C with the as-shipped source), compiled straight from JU09T1 into JU0900C (so the object does not depend on the copy) and also copied over member JU0900C with CPYSRCF (FIXMBR; a failure shows as FIXMBR FAILED in VFYLOG), then JU0900C PARM('*TEST' <USER>2) is the LAST cl step (hang rule) and must print the 12-line baseline (OK 10, SHORT 2) with no RPG0907. JU0900C is called directly (not via SBMJOB): SBMJOB is asynchronous, runs in another job and its spool would not reach the collect; the SBMJOB path is tested in part10-01-incident. The as-shipped RPG0907-at-stmt-8100 failure (S1) is NOT re-run here: it is already recorded by part05-ju0900c-baseline. The clone tree (~/ibmi-kyozai/src/legacy, db/data) that TXLEGACY and TXRESET read is created the way verify/part05-txlegacy-exec did (heredoc upload into staging members S10*, then CPYTOSTMF CCSID 1208 in sh steps), because heredoc-written files are CCSID 273 and TXLEGACY reads with STMFCCSID(1208).
